summary: This note is a wiki-style description of Eric Brady, a fictional character on the NBC soap opera Days of Our Lives. It covers his storyline involving Serena, Nicole, and Daniel Jonas, including his 2015-2016 downfall after Serena's murder and a fatal drunk-driving accident, and his prison sentence. It also gives production history: his childhood origins, Jensen Ackles' original portrayal from 1997 to 2000, and Greg Vaughan's casting from 2012 onward.
one_line: Eric Brady is a fictional Days of Our Lives character whose storylines include a 2016 fatal drunk-driving crash and his portrayal by Jensen Ackles and Greg Vaughan.
key_facts: Eric Brady is a fictional character from the NBC Daytime soap opera Days of Our Lives.
Eric's birth was portrayed on-screen in the episode of October 16, 1984, together with his twin sister Sami Brady's.
Jensen Ackles originated the role of adult Eric when the character was rapidly aged from a pre-teen to a young adult in July 1997.
Headwriter James E. Reilly was under whose pen the adult Eric was introduced in July 1997.
Ackles' Eric was seen for three years, until August 2000, when the character and Ackles departed.
Eric was reintroduced in 2012 with actor Greg Vaughan.
Greg Vaughan portrayed Eric Brady from 2012 until his exit in 2016.
Vaughan reprised the role in January 2017, following a discussion between him and executives at Days of Our Lives.
Eric has orders-free involvement with Serena, who is in town to retrieve an artwork containing smuggled diamonds that Eric acquired in Africa.
Eric's relationship with Serena bothers Nicole, who tries and fails several times to break it up.
Eric breaks up with Serena after discovering she slept with her boss, Xander Cook.
Xander locks Eric and Nicole in the basement of the news station, where they realize they still have feelings for each other.
When Eric and Nicole escape, Nicole, who is engaged to Daniel Jonas, breaks things off with Eric, leaving him devastated.
In August 2015, Eric finds Serena strangled to death in the park; she is the first victim of the Necktie Killer.
In January 2016, while driving drunk, Eric causes a car accident that injures himself, Brady and Jennifer Horton, and kills his best friend Daniel Jonas.
In April 2016, Eric is sentenced to five years in prison for vehicular manslaughter.
